cohort: final frozen revision after offline preflight
order: case-major, alternate baseline-first/Quick-first by case and repetition
baseline: no profile with human-approved common output cap; not entirely unmodified defaults
enhanced: public Quick profile with identical output cap
timing: graph construction + propagate + normal persistence; checkpoint/export IO excluded
isolation: fresh memory/cache/results each attempt, model checkpoints disabled
resume: same input and source digests only; completed runs never repeated
retry_policy: at most one whole-run retry of a transient execution failure; all attempts retained; never retry a completed rejected report
performance_target: TBD pending measured evidence and human adoption
